messages.text: What is measurement method, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

The passages do not give a formal standalone definition of “measurement method”; in context, it means the specified way a measurement is performed, including the reference procedure, setup, calibration approach, measured metric, and instrument/software conditions, as illustrated by the RSE substitution method, where the DUT is replaced by a calibrated antenna with signal generator, the generator level is tuned to the same receive value, and EIRP is calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss [4][16].
| Product-related measurement decision | Why it depends on the measurement method |
|---|---|
| Choose spectrum analyzer vs. EMI receiver | RSE tests can use a spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver; RF analysis needs a spectrum analyzer, while EMC test standards need an EMI receiver [17]. |
| Choose RSE substitution support | The RSE reference method is substitution, and R&S ELEKTRA supports this method [4][16]. |
| Choose EIRP, TRP, directional, or co-location measurement handling | 5G NR OTA transmitter test cases are classified by metric or method, e.g. radiated transmit power uses EIRP, OTA base station output power uses TRP, modulation quality is directional/EVM, and some spurious/co-location cases use TRP or co-location requirements [51]. |
| Choose TRP procedure and grid | TRP procedure choice depends on available test setup, measurement equipment, and measurement time [12]; TRP measurement grids include 2-cut, 3-cut, equal angle, equal area, and Fibonacci grids [13]. |
| Choose chamber/site geometry and distance | RSE test sites can be FAR with azimuth/optional elevation scan or SAC with height scan, and common test distance is 3 m, with 1 m used to improve sensitivity [17]. For 5G FR2 RSE procedures, typical test distance is 1 m above 40 GHz and 3 m below 40 GHz [7]. |
| Choose OTA test system / chamber product | R&S TS8991 with WPTC supports FR1 and FR2, R&S ATS1800C is a CATR-based 5G NR mmWave chamber suitable for FR2, and R&S PWC200 is suitable for FR1 OTA massive MIMO base station testing [53]. |
| Choose analyzer software option for 5G NR downlink measurements | The listed R&S signal and spectrum analyzers require the 5G NR downlink measurements software option R&S FSW-/FSV-/FSV3-/FPS-K144 [53]. |
| Choose calibration method, calibration kit, and measurement settings | R&S ZNL measurement accuracy conditions require the R&S ZV-Z270 or R&S ZN-Z235 calibration kit depending on port connector, calibration method TOSM/SOLT, identical frequency points/measurement bandwidth/sweep time for measurement and calibration, and no interpolation [30]. |
| Choose OTA calibration options | 5G NR OTA system calibration before testing uses SMW-K544 and FSW-K544, and the calibration accounts for cable losses, antenna losses, and OTA losses [54]. |
| Interpret whether a product specification is warranted | Specifications with limits and specifications without limits represent warranted product performance, while n. trc., typ., nom., and meas. values are not guaranteed by Rohde & Schwarz [2][43]. |

R&S SGT100A › Spectral purity
| 項目 | 條件 | 規格 |
|---|---|---|
| Harmonics | `level ≤ 8 dBm`, CW, I/Q wideband off | `< –30 dBc` |
| Nonharmonics | `level > –10 dBm`, `offset > 10 kHz from carrier`, `f ≤ 1500 MHz` | `< –76 dBc` |
| Nonharmonics | `level > –10 dBm`, `offset > 10 kHz from carrier`, `1500 MHz < f ≤ 3000 MHz` | `< –70 dBc` |
| Nonharmonics | `level > –10 dBm`, `offset > 10 kHz from carrier`, `3000 MHz < f ≤ 6000 MHz` | `< –64 dBc` |
| Subharmonics | `level > –10 dBm`, `f ≤ 3000 MHz` | `< –76 dBc` |
| Subharmonics | `level > –10 dBm`, `3000 MHz < f ≤ 6000 MHz` | `< –68 dBc` |
| Wideband noise | `1 MHz ≤ f ≤ 6 GHz`, `10 MHz carrier offset`, `level > 5 dBm`, setting characteristic `auto`, `1 Hz measurement bandwidth`, CW | `< –145 dBc` |
| Wideband noise | same condition, I/Q | `< –135 dBc` |

SSB phase noise 條件：`20 kHz carrier offset`, `1 Hz measurement bandwidth`。

| Frequency | SSB phase noise |
|---|---|
| `f = 1 GHz` | `< –126 dBc`; `–133 dBc (meas.)` |
| `f = 2 GHz` | `< –120 dBc`; `–127 dBc (meas.)` |
| `f = 6 GHz` | `< –110 dBc`; `–117 dBc (meas.)` |

R&S SGT100A › 資料適用條件與規格語彙
依 [[SGT100A_specs_en_3607-0217-22_v1400]]（Version 14.00，November 2024），產品資料適用條件包含：在環境溫度下儲存 `3 hours` 後進行 `30 minutes` warm-up operation、符合指定 environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval，且已執行所有內部 automatic adjustments（若適用）。

本來源對規格語彙的定義會影響是否可視為保證值：

- Specifications with limits 與 specifications without limits 代表 warranted product performance。
- `n. trc.`、`typ.`、`nom.`、`meas.` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- 3GPP 相關速率單位如 `Gbps`、`Mcps`、`Mbps`、`Msps`、`kbps`、`ksps`、`Msample/s` 在本文件中不是 SI units。

R&S SGT100A › General data
Power supply：

| 項目 | 規格 |
|---|---|
| AC input voltage range | `100 V to 240 V`, `±10 %` |
| AC supply frequency | `50 Hz to 60 Hz`, `±5 %` |
| Maximum input current | `1.7 A` |
| Power consumption | `65 W (meas.)` |
| Power factor correction | complies with `EN 61000-3-2` |

Compliance / environmental：

- Electrical safety compliance：`IEC 61010-1`, `EN 61010-1`, `CAN/CSA-C22.2 No. 61010-1-04`, `UL 61010-1`。
- Test marks：`VDE-GS`, `CSA C US`。
- EMC：`EN 55011 class A`, `EN 61326-1 (industrial environment)`, `EN 61326-2-1`。
- Vibration sinusoidal：`5 Hz to 150 Hz`，55 Hz 時 max. `2 g`，55 Hz to 150 Hz 時 const. `0.5 g`，符合 `EN 60068-2-6`。
- Vibration random：`10 Hz to 300 Hz`，acceleration `1.2 g (RMS)`，符合 `EN 60068-2-64`。
- Shock：`40 g shock spectrum`，符合 `MIL-STD-810E`, method no. 516.4, procedure I。
- Operating temperature range：`0 °C to +50 °C`，符合 `EN 60068-2-1`, `EN 60068-2-2`。
- Storage temperature range：`–40 °C to +71 °C`。
- Climatic resistance：`+40 °C / 95 % relative humidity`，符合 `EN 60068-2-30`。
- Altitude：operating up to `4600 m`；storage up to `4600 m`。

Dimensions / weight：

| 條件 | Dimensions | Weight |
|---|---|---|
| without `R&S®SGT-B88` option | `246 mm × 52.5 mm × 401 mm (9.69 in × 2.07 in × 15.79 in)`, `1 HU`, `½ 19 inch rack width` | fully equipped `4.0 kg (8.82 lb)` |
| with `R&S®SGT-B88` option | `246 mm × 98 mm × 401 mm (9.69 in × 3.86 in × 15.79 in)`, `2 HU`, `½ 19 inch rack width` | `4.6 kg (10.14 lb)` |

Calibration interval：recommended calibration interval `3 years`，條件 `40 h/week operation in the full range of the specified environmental conditions`。

R&S ELEKTRA › Substitution method
依來源：

- RSE measurement including substitution 的 reference method 為 substitution。
- DUT replaced by a calibrated antenna with signal generator。
- Signal generator level tuned to same receive value as DUT。
- EIRP calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss。
- Supported by ELEKTRA。

R&S ELEKTRA › User interface and EUT management
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- User interface 被描述為 sleek, fast and modern。
- Dashboard 提供 quick access to favorite items。
- 支援 tagging、filtering and searching。
- 採 all-in-one page interface。
- EUT management 可 define a list of tests to be executed for multiple EUTs。
- 可查看 test results status。
- 可 manage users and projects with access rights。
- 可 create reports with results from multiple tests，並 post process in MS Word。

R&S ELEKTRA › Multi-band measurement
依來源：

- ELEKTRA Multi Band Measurement 可 speed up overview measurement by running up to **4 antennas / receivers** in parallel。
- 可 simultaneously measure up to **4 frequency subranges**。

R&S ELEKTRA › 5G FR2 test procedure support
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- ELEKTRA is next generation EMC test SW。
- For 5G support of RSE measurement procedures with extension for 5G FR2。
- 支援 3D and TRP evaluation。
- 支援 5G signaling with [[R&S CMX500]]。
- Mixers and calibration procedure also supported by EMC32。
- EMI test sequence adopted to support RSE requirements。
- Sweeps 可 free run（for FDD）或 gated sweep（triggered by CMX, for TDD）。
- 支援 elevation positioner。
- 支援 3D view possibility for overview measurement, maximization and final TRP measurement。
- Typical test distance: **1 m for >40 GHz** and **3 m for <40 GHz**。
- Workflow steps 包含 overview measurement、data reduction、maximization、adjustment、final measurement。
- Virtual RMS detectors with **100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth** 可把 lower bandwidth measurement integration over 100 MHz / 200 MHz sliding window，用於平行量測 -13 dBm/MHz 與 -10 dBm/100 MHz limits。

R&S ELEKTRA › SAC height-scan correction
依來源：

- FAR precalibrated measurement 中 antenna height、DUT height、test distance constant，因此 free space loss constant。
- SAC precalibrated measurement 中 DUT height and horizontal test distance constant，但 effective test distance depends on antenna height。
- ELEKTRA can correct this test distance variation automatically。

R&S ELEKTRA › ELEMI-OOB burst analysis
依來源：

- [[ELEMI-OOB]] 是 TX burst trigger / burst analysis for RSE final measurement according to ETSI。
- 適用 unlicensed bands final measurement。
- Zero span with ≤1 µs resolution, RMS detector。
- Burst detection with trigger search。
- Average power of highest burst。
- Automatic analysis and storage of trace。

R&S ELEKTRA › Wireless EMC / EMS extension
[[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]] 另列出 wireless EMC / EMS 相關功能：

- Wireless EMC Extension: EMI tests for wireless devices；radiated and conducted emission test according ETSI EN 301 489；signaling also in EMI measurements supported。
- EMS tests for wireless devices：susceptibility tests according [[TS 134.124]] and ETSI EN 301 489。
- Signaling options include link quality measurement for wireless devices with data application，例如 BER、BLER、FER、PER。
- Radiated EMS tests for wireless devices with audio：susceptibility tests according TS 134.124 and ETSI EN 301 489；audio measurement for wireless devices with audio functionality。
- ELEKTRA option [[ELEMS-ABT]]；uses external audio analyzer or CMW internal audio analyzer；application note available with detailed setup description。

R&S ELEKTRA › 3D EIRP Evaluation / ELEMI-3D
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 量測 [[EIRP]]（Effective Isotropic Radiated Power）instead of field strength。
- 支援 SAC and FAR 3D measurement。
- 支援 elevation positioner。
- 支援 spherical elevation 或 cylindrical height scan。
- 支援 3D result presentation。
- option 名稱為 [[ELEMI-3D]]。

TRP › TRP measurement procedures
來源列出多種 TRP procedures：

1. Full sphere using reference steps（accurate）。
2. Full sphere using sparse sampling（overestimate）。
3. Two cuts + Pattern multiplication（accurate）；Pattern multiplication 是 conditional。
4. Two/three cuts（overestimate）。
5. Beam-based directions。
6. Peak method。
7. Equal sector with peak average。
8. Pre-scan。

來源指出 procedure 選擇取決於 available test setup、measurement equipment 與 measurement time。

TRP › TRP measurement grids
來源列出 TRP measurement grids：

- 2-cut grid。
- 3-cut grid。
- Equal angle grid。
- Equal area grid。
- Fibonacci grid。

來源說 TRP measurement grids 參考 [[3GPP TR 37.941]] subsection 6.3.4。

TRP › 使用限制
- 本頁只保存 GFM324 對 TRP 的 OTA BS transmitter testing 語境，不是 antenna measurement 標準全文。
- 不可由本頁推論任一產品、基地台或天線的 TRP 規格。
- TRP procedure、grid density、uncertainty budget 與 applicability 需回查 [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]]、[[3GPP TR 37.941]] 與 R&S application note 原文。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › RSE 與 EIRP / TRP
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- [[R&S ELEKTRA]] 支援 3D [[EIRP]] evaluation：量測 Effective Isotropic Radiated Power instead of field strength。
- 5G FR2 來源多以 [[TRP]] method 表示 test requirement。
- ETSI 301 908-25 draft 來源描述 two-step method：先用 EIRP coarse grid 找 spurious frequencies，再對 EIRP above limit 的 frequencies 執行 TRP fine grid。
- Final measurement 可計算 2-cut TRP、3-cut TRP；若 limit exceeded，另執行 full TRP。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › Substitution method
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- Reference method: substitution。
- DUT replaced by calibrated antenna with signal generator。
- Signal generator level tuned to same receive value as DUT。
- EIRP calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss。
- [[R&S ELEKTRA]] supports this method。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › 在 R&S solution mapping 中的位置
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- RSE 出現在 CE RED Art 3.2 radio spectrum 與 FCC wireless regulatory testing 語境。
- 來源將 [[R&S TS8996]] 列為 RSE solution mapping。
- 來源對 5G FR2 提到 RSE up to 200 GHz、high sensitivity -40 dBm/MHz、special signaling、conditioning for carrier 與 all standards support。
- RSE test can use spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver；RF analysis need spectrum analyzer，EMC test standards need EMI receiver。

依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- RSE has always to be evaluated, also for precertified modules。
- Basic RSE setup 類似 commercial EMI test。
- TS8996 supports 2G / 3G / 4G / 5G FR1 / WLAN / BT，並可擴充到 5G FR2 / above 40 GHz。
- 測試場地可為 FAR with azimuth / optional elevation scan，或 SAC with height scan。
- 常見 test distance 為 3 m；為提高 sensitivity 可使用 1 m。
- Signal conditioning 是 RSE 的關鍵，因為 high-power carrier 可能使 receiver / analyzer overload，特別是 near-carrier measurement。

FR2 OTA spatial test metrics › TRP @ Beam Peak metric
來源文字：

- TRP metric – two antennas required, link + measurement。
- Lock the beam in best TX beam。
- Measure power per grid point。
- Calculate average。

判斷：本來源將 [[TRP]] @ beam peak 描述為固定最佳 TX beam 後，在 sphere grid 上量測 power 並平均；此處是 FR2 UE conformance presentation 的簡化說明，正式 grid / uncertainty / integration method 仍需回查 3GPP 或 application note。

FR2 OTA spatial test metrics › EIRP @ Beam Peak / TX Beam Peak metric
來源文字：

- EIRP metric：In best TX beam peak direction measure power。
- TX Beam peak metric：Same as EIRP but non-power measurement, e.g. EVM。
- For chapter 6 the beam peak is Tx beam peak = 100%-tile of EIRP CDF = strongest beam。

因此在此來源中：

- Power measurement at strongest TX beam 可用 [[EIRP]] @ beam peak。
- 非 power measurement，例如 [[EVM]]，也可使用 TX beam peak direction 作為量測方向。

FR2 OTA spatial test metrics › EIRP CDF metric
來源文字：

- EIRP CDF metric：3D EIRP scan with the same link & measurement antenna, CDF for power。
- 來源把 spherical coverage 連到 EIRP CDF metric。

判斷：本來源將 [[EIRP]] CDF 作為 TX scan / spherical coverage 類 metric；這補充 [[EIRP]] 既有頁的方向性 radiated power 定義，但不取代 GFM324 的 formal test context。

FR2 OTA spatial test metrics › 使用限制
- 本頁主要依 [[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]] Slide 10 整理，該來源是 2020-11-02 customer presentation 的 lossy derivative，不是 3GPP 標準全文。
- Slide 10 中部分 test case numbering / labels 可能受 OCR 影響，例如 TX Spurious Emissions 與 6.5.3.1 的排列需回查原始投影片。
- 本頁只保存 metric taxonomy 與來源語句，不提供測試限值、grid definition、uncertainty、measurement bandwidth、beam management procedure 或 pass/fail criteria。
- [[EIRP]]、[[TRP]] 與 [[EIS]] 的正式定義與測試程序需回查對應 3GPP、R&S application note 或 chamber / test system 文件。

EIRP › 使用限制
- 本頁只保存 GFM324 對 EIRP 的測試語境定義，不是天線理論或法規標準全文。
- 不可由本頁推論任一產品、基地台或天線的 EIRP 規格。
- EIRP limits、measurement uncertainty、antenna gain table 與 calibration method 需回查對應 3GPP / R&S 文件。

EIRP › 在 GFM324 測試中的用途
來源明示使用 EIRP measurement 的 test cases：

- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] 6.2 Radiated transmit power。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] 6.5.1 OTA transmitter OFF power（EIRP in beam peak）。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] 6.5.2 OTA transmitter transient period。

在 6.2 Radiated transmit power 測試中，來源說 radiated transmit power 定義為 declared beam 在特定 beam peak direction 的 EIRP level，且每個 declared conformance beam direction pair 的 EIRP measurement 必須相對於 manufacturer declared rated beam EIRP value 維持在規定範圍內。

5G NR Base Station Conformance Testing › Measurement uncertainty 與 calibration
依 [[5G NR Base station conformance testing - EN - UR_Public]]（2023-06）：

- Conducted measurement uncertainties and test requirements 引用 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] section 4.1.2。
- Transmitter tests 範例：6.2 Base Station output power、6.5.2 EVM、6.5.3 Time alignment error。
- Receiver tests 範例：7.2 Reference sensitivity level。
- Performance requirements 範例：PUSCH、PUCCH、PRACH with fading channel。
- OTA test system acceptable uncertainty 在 [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] chapter 4.1.2 指定；test requirement combines MU and minimum requirement。
- OTA uncertainty contributors 摘錄自 [[3GPP TR 37.843]]，包含 probe position、probe pattern knowledge、measurement distance、multiple reflections、mismatch of receiver chain、absolute gain of probe antenna、measurement repeatability / positioning repeatability。
- OTA measurement chamber specific calibration procedures captured in [[3GPP TR 37.843]]。
- FR2 OTA test requirements specific and chamber specific calibration procedures are for further study（FFS），potential reuse of FR1 calibration procedures for FR2 is FFS。
- Calibration measurements with SMW / FSW 可使用 reference antenna gain comparison 或 gain transfer method；SMW 與 FSW 可用 K544 user defined frequency correction / User-Corr.。

Measurement accuracy 資料有效條件：

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

本來源對規格語彙的定義如下：

- Specifications with limits：代表 warranted product performance，並以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等範圍或限制符號標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（`n. trc.`）：依 specifications with limits 的方式指定與測試，但因缺少可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：代表指定參數的 warranted product performance，不特別標記；通常是 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等與給定值無或可忽略偏差的值。
- Typical data（`typ.`）：描述 representative product performance；若標示 `<`、`>` 或 range，代表約 `80%` instruments 在 production time 可達成。
- Nominal values（`nom.`）：代表值，不做 statistical evaluation，production 期間不測試。
- Measured values（`meas.`）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 為 `2`，依 GUM 規則計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits`、`typical data`、`nominal values`、`measured values` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- 依 3GPP standard，本文件中的 `Gbps`、`Mcps`、`Mbps`、`Msps`、`kbps`、`ksps`、`Msample/s` 不是 SI units。

answer.text:
The passages do not give a formal standalone definition of “measurement method”; in context, it means the specified way a measurement is performed, including the reference procedure, setup, calibration approach, measured metric, and instrument/software conditions, as illustrated by the RSE substitution method, where the DUT is replaced by a calibrated antenna with signal generator, the generator level is tuned to the same receive value, and EIRP is calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss [4][16].
| Product-related measurement decision | Why it depends on the measurement method |
|---|---|
| Choose spectrum analyzer vs. EMI receiver | RSE tests can use a spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver; RF analysis needs a spectrum analyzer, while EMC test standards need an EMI receiver [17]. |
| Choose RSE substitution support | The RSE reference method is substitution, and R&S ELEKTRA supports this method [4][16]. |
| Choose EIRP, TRP, directional, or co-location measurement handling | 5G NR OTA transmitter test cases are classified by metric or method, e.g. radiated transmit power uses EIRP, OTA base station output power uses TRP, modulation quality is directional/EVM, and some spurious/co-location cases use TRP or co-location requirements [51]. |
| Choose TRP procedure and grid | TRP procedure choice depends on available test setup, measurement equipment, and measurement time [12]; TRP measurement grids include 2-cut, 3-cut, equal angle, equal area, and Fibonacci grids [13]. |
| Choose chamber/site geometry and distance | RSE test sites can be FAR with azimuth/optional elevation scan or SAC with height scan, and common test distance is 3 m, with 1 m used to improve sensitivity [17]. For 5G FR2 RSE procedures, typical test distance is 1 m above 40 GHz and 3 m below 40 GHz [7]. |
| Choose OTA test system / chamber product | R&S TS8991 with WPTC supports FR1 and FR2, R&S ATS1800C is a CATR-based 5G NR mmWave chamber suitable for FR2, and R&S PWC200 is suitable for FR1 OTA massive MIMO base station testing [53]. |
| Choose analyzer software option for 5G NR downlink measurements | The listed R&S signal and spectrum analyzers require the 5G NR downlink measurements software option R&S FSW-/FSV-/FSV3-/FPS-K144 [53]. |
| Choose calibration method, calibration kit, and measurement settings | R&S ZNL measurement accuracy conditions require the R&S ZV-Z270 or R&S ZN-Z235 calibration kit depending on port connector, calibration method TOSM/SOLT, identical frequency points/measurement bandwidth/sweep time for measurement and calibration, and no interpolation [30]. |
| Choose OTA calibration options | 5G NR OTA system calibration before testing uses SMW-K544 and FSW-K544, and the calibration accounts for cable losses, antenna losses, and OTA losses [54]. |
| Interpret whether a product specification is warranted | Specifications with limits and specifications without limits represent warranted product performance, while n. trc., typ., nom., and meas. values are not guaranteed by Rohde & Schwarz [2][43]. |

R&S ELEKTRA › Substitution method
依來源：

- RSE measurement including substitution 的 reference method 為 substitution。
- DUT replaced by a calibrated antenna with signal generator。
- Signal generator level tuned to same receive value as DUT。
- EIRP calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss。
- Supported by ELEKTRA。

R&S ELEKTRA › 5G FR2 test procedure support
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- ELEKTRA is next generation EMC test SW。
- For 5G support of RSE measurement procedures with extension for 5G FR2。
- 支援 3D and TRP evaluation。
- 支援 5G signaling with [[R&S CMX500]]。
- Mixers and calibration procedure also supported by EMC32。
- EMI test sequence adopted to support RSE requirements。
- Sweeps 可 free run（for FDD）或 gated sweep（triggered by CMX, for TDD）。
- 支援 elevation positioner。
- 支援 3D view possibility for overview measurement, maximization and final TRP measurement。
- Typical test distance: **1 m for >40 GHz** and **3 m for <40 GHz**。
- Workflow steps 包含 overview measurement、data reduction、maximization、adjustment、final measurement。
- Virtual RMS detectors with **100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth** 可把 lower bandwidth measurement integration over 100 MHz / 200 MHz sliding window，用於平行量測 -13 dBm/MHz 與 -10 dBm/100 MHz limits。

2. Full sphere using sparse sampling（overestimate）。
3. Two cuts + Pattern multiplication（accurate）；Pattern multiplication 是 conditional。
4. Two/three cuts（overestimate）。
5. Beam-based directions。
6. Peak method。
7. Equal sector with peak average。
8. Pre-scan。

來源指出 procedure 選擇取決於 available test setup、measurement equipment 與 measurement time。

依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- RSE 出現在 CE RED Art 3.2 radio spectrum 與 FCC wireless regulatory testing 語境。
- 來源將 [[R&S TS8996]] 列為 RSE solution mapping。
- 來源對 5G FR2 提到 RSE up to 200 GHz、high sensitivity -40 dBm/MHz、special signaling、conditioning for carrier 與 all standards support。
- RSE test can use spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver；RF analysis need spectrum analyzer，EMC test standards need EMI receiver。

依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- RSE has always to be evaluated, also for precertified modules。
- Basic RSE setup 類似 commercial EMI test。
- TS8996 supports 2G / 3G / 4G / 5G FR1 / WLAN / BT，並可擴充到 5G FR2 / above 40 GHz。
- 測試場地可為 FAR with azimuth / optional elevation scan，或 SAC with height scan。
- 常見 test distance 為 3 m；為提高 sensitivity 可使用 1 m。
- Signal conditioning 是 RSE 的關鍵，因為 high-power carrier 可能使 receiver / analyzer overload，特別是 near-carrier measurement。

R&S ZNL › Measurement accuracy 與 effective system data 條件
Measurement accuracy 資料有效條件：

- 溫度 +18 °C to +28 °C。
- Calibration 後溫度變化不超過 1 °C。
- 依 port connector 使用 [[R&S ZV-Z270]] 或 [[R&S ZN-Z235]] calibration kit。
- Calibration method：TOSM/SOLT。
- Frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 在 measurement 與 calibration 時必須相同。
- 不允許 interpolation。

Effective system data 另基於 source power –10 dBm、measurement bandwidth 10 Hz。

| 項目 | 5 kHz to 10 GHz | 10 GHz to 20 GHz |
|---|---:|---:|
| Directivity | ≥ 46 dB | ≥ 42 dB |
| Source match | ≥ 40 dB | ≥ 37 dB |
| Load match | ≥ 42 dB | ≥ 38 dB |
| Reflection tracking | ≤ 0.07 dB | ≤ 0.09 dB |
| Transmission tracking | ≤ 0.06 dB | ≤ 0.06 dB |

Factory-calibrated system data 條件：+18 °C to +28 °C、source power –10 dBm、measurement bandwidth 1 kHz。Directivity 100 kHz to 20 GHz specification ≥ 20 dB / typical 35 dB；source match 100 kHz to 20 GHz specification ≥ 20 dB / typical 35 dB。

SGT100A_specs_en_3607-0217-22_v1400 › 資料適用條件與規格語彙
依本來源，產品資料適用條件包含：在環境溫度下儲存 `3 hours` 後進行 `30 minutes` warm-up operation、符合指定 environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval，且已執行所有內部 automatic adjustments（若適用）。

本來源對規格語彙的定義如下：

- Specifications with limits：代表 warranted product performance，並以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等範圍或限制符號標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（`n. trc.`）：依 specifications with limits 的方式指定與測試，但因缺少可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：代表指定參數的 warranted product performance，不特別標記；通常是 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等與給定值無或可忽略偏差的值。
- Typical data（`typ.`）：描述 representative product performance；若標示 `<`、`>` 或 range，代表約 `80%` instruments 在 production time 可達成。
- Nominal values（`nom.`）：代表值，不做 statistical evaluation，production 期間不測試。
- Measured values（`meas.`）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 為 `2`，依 GUM 規則計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits`、`typical data`、`nominal values`、`measured values` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- 依 3GPP standard，本文件中的 `Gbps`、`Mcps`、`Mbps`、`Msps`、`kbps`、`ksps`、`Msample/s` 不是 SI units。
